## Publications portfolio

This page presents selected academic work through an applied analytics lens. My publications focus on population health, spatial inequality, forecasting, workforce trajectories, and quantitative methods. Together, they show a consistent interest in using rigorous analytic approaches to address real world problems.

View my full publication record on [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=ihmc__0AAAAJ).

## Publications by theme

```{r}
#| results: 'asis'
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

pubs <- read_csv("publications_portfolio.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Strip LaTeX bib artifacts like {US}, {JAMA}
pubs <- pubs %>%
  mutate(title = gsub("\\{|\\}", "", title),
         journal = gsub("\\{|\\}", "", journal))

themes <- unique(pubs$theme)

cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")

for (th in themes) {
  cat("## ", th, "\n\n", sep = "")

  theme_df <- pubs %>%
    filter(theme == th) %>%
    arrange(desc(year))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(theme_df))) {
    row <- theme_df[i, ]
    cat("#### ", row$title, " (", row$year, ")\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("*", row$journal, "*  \n", sep = "")
    cat("DOI: [", row$doi, "](https://doi.org/", row$doi, ")  \n\n", sep = "")
    cat(row$portfolio_summary, "\n\n")
    cat("---\n\n")
  }
}

cat(":::\n")
```
